subject: Request: One-time PLG credit top-up for NovaHealth trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-time PLG credit top-up for NovaHealth trial

Hi Laura / Markus —

Quick ask: NovaHealth (Samantha Price) is stuck in the trial because their ingestion volume spikes during onboarding. They signed up self-serve, have hit their initial free credits, and have requested an immediate top-up so they can finish a 2-week proof run. If we don't extend, they will pause and likely push the POC to later in the quarter.

Why this matters:
- ARR motion: NovaHealth is a vertical SaaS with an expected 6–9 month sales cycle; current forecast (attached) shows a ~75% chance to convert to a committed plan worth $180k ARR if the POC completes and passes quality tests.
- Timing: they asked for a $25k credit to cover predicted token consumption for the remainder of the POC.
- Precedent: we reserve high-touch credits for strategic, near-term-convertible accounts. This is a self-serve signup that surfaced as a clear expansion opportunity.

Request: leadership sign-off to issue a one-time $25,000 credit (account level) to NovaHealth and extend the trial window by 14 days. I'll log terms in HubSpot and attach a mutual action plan.

Attachments: novahealth_trial_forecast.xlsx (sales forecast), proposed-mop.pdf (recommended MAP)

Would appreciate a quick greenlight — Samantha is waiting for an answer today.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time PLG credit top-up for NovaHealth trial

Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the forecast. A couple quick clarifying items before I take to Markus:
1) How sticky is the technical win? Do they have incumbent contracts we need to displace?
2) What specific metric will we use to validate POC success (latency, quality eval, integration completion)? Suggest we capture a single go/no-go criterion in the MAP.
3) Can you confirm the credit is conditioned on them signing an LOI or committing to a partner-intro call within 30 days of POC completion?

If you can update the MAP and confirm the conditionality, I'm comfortable recommending up to $25k as a one-time top-up. If finance flags budget we can do $15k with a strong LOI requirement.

Please push an updated MAP to the Drive link and I'll loop Markus for sign-off.

Laura
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time PLG credit top-up for NovaHealth trial

Laura —

Answers below and I uploaded an updated MAP to the Drive link. I also attached a one-page summary in the thread. Key points:

1) Incumbent: They evaluated a managed competitor but never signed; primary friction was price and latency on large batches. No existing enterprise contract to terminate — low legal/capture risk.

2) Success metric: the POC will be deemed successful if we achieve >= 92% match rate on their internal annotation set (they provided baseline eval) and average response < 800ms at 8k tokens/session for their top workflows. I've captured both metrics in the MAP under Section 2.

3) Conditioning the credit: agree to require an LOI or a signed MOU committing to a pricing discussion within 30 days of successful POC. If they don't provide LOI, credit is void. I've added the clause to the MAP and to the HubSpot deal notes.

Updated request: issue $20k credit conditioned on LOI within 30 days; if leadership prefers the full $25k we can make it contingent on a CFO-level exec intro and LOI.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-proposed-mop
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421

Karthik

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time PLG credit top-up for NovaHealth trial

Karthik / Laura —

Finance review quick take:
- $20k conditional credit (LOI within 30 days) is within our discretionary zone for ACV < $250k; no separate board approval needed.
- We need an internal cost-coverage note (estimate of expected token consumption vs. credit value). Karthik — can you paste the expected token burn over 14 days so I can sign off on the ledger entries?
- Please add a clause to HubSpot noting credits are non-refundable and expire 60 days after issue if not consumed.

If those items are satisfied I can mark as approved and instruct billing to issue the credit memo.

Tessa
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

All —

I'm comfortable approving a one-time $20k credit conditioned on the LOI + the success metrics Karthik outlined and with the standard non-refundable/expiry language Tessa requested. If LAURA wants to pursue the $25k option, we need a short note from Karthik confirming a CFO-level intro will be scheduled in the POC window.

Next steps:
- Karthik: paste the 14-day token burn estimate and attach the updated MAP to HubSpot.
- Tessa: once estimate is posted, please create the credit memo (Net 0 offset) and set expiry 60 days from issue.
- Laura: if you want $25k, confirm the additional CFO-intro commitment.

Markus
